name: tpl-responded-existence-1-nogoal
task: If you pick up the key, you must also open the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'If you pick up the key, you must also open the door' is a condition with the no-timing cue 'also', so RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) as a hard clause is the right template, with the trigger first. The agent starts with empty hands, so F(has_door_key) means the key was picked up. No goal is commanded, so no Existence is needed, and the rule-only warning is valid. The in-either-order reading is harmless because the door cannot open before the key.

texts: If the agent ever picks up the key, the door must also be opened at some point in the episode (in either order).
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key) -> u1
(u0, door_open) -> u2
(u1, door_open) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, door_open, u2) -> 1
